newsitem.title: EU: EP Economic Committee agenda - July 1-2.
newsitem.headline: EP Economic Committee agenda - July 1-2.

text.p: Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs and Industrial Policy [[ Tuesday 01 July 1997 ]] SUBCOMMITTEE ON MONETARY AFFAIRS
2. Approval of minutes of meetings of: - 7 May 1997 (PE222.605 ) - 20-21 May 1997 (PE222.603 )
5. Meeting with Mr Yves-Thibault de SILGUY, Member of the Commission, on the latest ECOFIN Council (from 15.00-16.00) - Statement by the Commission followed by exchange of views

6. Convergence criteria, the third stage of EMU and the various social security systems (T04222) INI0514 INI0514 B4-0589/95 B4-0589/95 + ECON Fond R WILLOCKX Frederik A. (PE217.722/A ) (PSE) - Decision on procedure
7. International dimension of the Euro (SNA0184 ) ( PE221.838 ) - Rapporteur: Mr RUFFOLO - Consideration of draft report

8. Allocation of financial intermediation services indirectly measured (FISIM) within the ESA (T04341) CNS97037 COM(97)0050 C4-0138/97 + ECON Fond R KATIFORIS Georgios. (PSE) - Initial exchange of views
9. Commission proposal concerning the face value and technical specifications of the future Euro coins (Procedure: cooperation) - Rapporteur: Mr WOLF - Initial exchange of views
10. The Euro and the consumer (SNA0193 ) - Rapporteur: ... (PSE) - Initial exchange of views
11. The Euro and tourism (SNA0194 ) - Rapporteur: ... (PSE) - Initial exchange of views
12. The treatment of member states' gold and foreign currency reserves (SNA0195 ) - Rapporteur: Mr GIANSILY (UPE) - Initial exchange of views
13. The Euro and the financial markets (SNA0196 ) - Rapporteur: Mr FRIEDRICH (PPE) - Initial exchange of views

14. Meeting with Mr MERSCH, Director of the Treasury, Luxembourg, on the agenda of the Luxembourg presidency and presentation of the new Euro coins(from 9.00) - Statement followed by exchange of views
15. Meeting with Mr Luis Angel ROJO, Governor of the Bank of Spain, on the outlook for Spanish progression to stage 3 of EMU (from 10.30) - Statement followed by exchange of views
17. Date of next meeting (PE/IV/OJ/97-09/MONE ) - FIN - END OF DOCUMENT.
